scope: Actual native66 request-correlated production CPU snapshots. Current entity-bound CPU buffers/materials/images; not GPU readback, rendered acceptance, independent external oracle, continuous playback proof, or complete asset-store disposal. Ordinary GUI Save/Open and Player provenance are separate.

coverage.global_time4: At the eight-second arms+knee timeline boundary, global4 selects knee source0. Arm source4 is recorded separately after an arms-only shared SetTimeline command.
coverage.lifecycle_retention: After each rejected Open, a fresh capture exactly equals the held baseline Work JSON/hash, complete exported appearance/base buffers and captured identity.
coverage.legacy_migration: Exact schema3 content preserved, with schema4 and explicit None appearance; current skin/accessory bindings absent.
coverage.same_content_open: Identical migrated Work publishes a fresh generation and body.
coverage.continuous_playback: NOT-ESTABLISHED by these paused sampling records. --benchmark was used only for continuous app update cadence.

binary.scope: Exported binary identity matches the r4 artifact receipt; source/artifact receipts are separate evidence. CLI-only help changes are outside this GUI cohort.

ordinary_native_ui_save.scope: File hash/content checked; ordinary toolbar Save provenance is root-observed and separate from bridge records. Cached actual CLI validate returned valid=true and asset_checked=true.

first_harness_failure.classification: Harness sequencing failure, outside the102-request cohort and103 count including boot.
first_harness_failure.reason: The sender submitted a new request while an earlier boot request remained pending. The bridge explicitly rejected it.
first_harness_failure.recovery: Wait for each terminal acknowledgement; replay the successful matrix in a fresh app with fresh IDs.

publication.raw_requests_reports: Exact byte copies; no redaction/reformatting. SHA256 inventories are included per pair.
publication.privacy: Every copied UTF-8 JSON file inspected for actual home/temp paths and common credential patterns. Private raw summary files containing absolute paths were not copied.
publication.source_events: Lifecycle/endpoint source event fingerprints checked against the copied raw byte hashes; private original events/summaries omitted.
publication.ordinary_gui_player: Separate root evidence; this folder does not certify those interactions.
publication.web_exchange: Separate evidence; no native/Web exchange claim from native CPU captures.
